facts.name: Project document search
facts.described_as: Search inside this project's documents (including imported Drive files).

hints.purpose: Finds the passages in this project's own documents that speak to a question, ranked by relevance, each with its document and page so the answer can cite it.

not_to_be_confused_with.difference: That one searches the platform's library of standards and guidance, not this project's documents.
That one reads one named document whole; this one finds passages across all of them.
A search returns a few ranked passages, never every row of a bill, so it cannot give a count or total.

question_kinds.how: Search for the clause, note or line the question is about and answer from the passage it returns, citing its document and page.
Finds which bill and which wording the rows use; the count or total itself comes from the bill row tool, not from adding ranked passages.
Run one search for the specification clause and another for the bill item; the answer joins the two passages and cites both documents.
Run one search for the specification clause and another for the drawing note, schedule or title block; cite both documents.
